MP4DX - Random Bonus Stars: At the start of every game (Party and Story Mode) 3 Bonus Stars are picked at random from Mini-Game, Coin, Happening, Item (most items used), Shopping (most coins spent in Item Shops), Running (most spaces moved), Slow (fewest spaces moved), Red (most Red Spaces) and Bowser (most Bowser Spaces). The host announces them after the turn order and awards them at the end of the game. In Party Mode it follows the Bonus Stars On/Off setting.
Requires the 'bonus stars' ISO (new host text in mess/board_e.dat, bank 56). Only for MP4 DX (GMPE01).
